headline: Binance Reserves $6.34 Billion Following Cyberattack
summary: Binance CEO announced that the exchange has reserved $6.34 billion to cover stolen assets after a cyberattack, with $5 billion already held in the affected cryptocurrency tokens.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume. Security breaches and subsequent reserve allocations directly influence market confidence in digital asset platforms and liquidity.

impacts.name: Binance
impacts.why: Setting aside substantial reserves impacts platform capital and liquidity management following a major security incident.

why_moved: Substantial security breaches and large reserve allocations create uncertainty regarding platform solvency and user funds security across digital asset markets.
